legend.best: highest coverage, then most detections beyond the reference; find its genome in status.xml by its individual name
legend.faults_by_best_status: each fault counted once, with the best status any program reached: DD detected, NO excited but not seen at the boundary, NC never excited, U* untestable
legend.missed_by_group: faults no program detected, per hardware feature, with what a program usually needs to reach them
legend.missed_by_signal: faults no program detected, per signal
legend.events_seen: forwarding events, with how many programs produced each
legend.replays: traces of single faults that the best program excited but missed

exception fields.needs: instructions that raise exceptions, and a trap handler that returns

branch prediction and resolution.needs: taken and not-taken branches and jumps

register clobber select.needs: more registers, written by different units (load, multiply, ...)

program counter.needs: code spread over more addresses; high PC bits stay constant

data paths.needs: more varied values, carried on to a store or the signature

register and ID fields.needs: more registers and longer dependency chains

coprocessor interface (CVXIF).needs: no coprocessor is attached: no program can reach these
